Records the screen with your face in a round bubble inside the video. Nothing appears on your screen while recording. Android asks for permission to record the screen each time — on Android 14+ you can pick a single app (e.g., Instagram) and only it will be recorded.

The video starts when you leave Hahacam. If you stop from the notification, the last seconds (reaching for the phone) are cut. If you stop in the app, the video ends when you came back.
Cut from the end when stopping from the notification
Floating “Start” button and live preview of me

After you tap Start here, a small floating window with your live bubble and a “Start” button appears over Instagram. Tap it when you\'re 100% ready; tap “Stop” in it to finish. Needs the “Display over other apps” permission. In screen mode choose “A single app” in Android\'s prompt — then the floating window is not recorded into the video.
